additional_info.body:
Tanya Meghani was assigned as new Case Manager for case 0452868 .
Link to Case:
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=incident&id=6e075475-cf9d-f011-b41b-7ced8d40657e

I’m reaching out because charging point no. 3 of the station is very
frequently out of order. At the moment, the charging point is
showing an error “SECC is initializing” on our backend and appears
as deactivated on SCB.
It’s been at least a week that the charging point has been regularly
unavailable due to this error. Sometimes it becomes available again
without any action on our part.
Could you please provide me with an update on the situation? Is an
on-site intervention to be expected?
